empirical_basis.AR-036_insights: 002_v4_safeguard_fortress was best overall at 5-11 (31.2%), with 75% vs Crustle and 50% vs Alakazam. Failure mode against Lucario/Ivan was non-ex bypass and energy clunkiness of off-color Psychic cards.

007_anti_lucario_neutralization_fortress.tactical_mechanism: Neutralization Zone (ID 1247 ACE SPEC) makes non-Rule-Box Tapu Bulu (140 HP) and Mimikyu (70 HP) take 0 damage from Mega Lucario ex, allowing Wood Hammer (220 dmg) to dismantle Lucario safely.
007_anti_lucario_neutralization_fortress.energy_system: 100% Basic Grass Energy + Darkness (Zero off-color clunkiness)

008_anti_lucario_energy_denial.json.tactical_mechanism: 4x Crushing Hammer (ID 1120) + 2x Handheld Fan (ID 1161) strips Fighting Energy off Mega Lucario every time it attacks, locking it out of Mega Brave (cost {F}{F}{C}).

009_anti_ivan_non_ex_swat.json.tactical_mechanism: 3x Tapu Bulu (Wood Hammer 220 dmg) OHKOs Hariyama (150 HP), Solrock (110 HP) and Makuhita (80 HP) in 1 hit; Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex (ID 44) provides 240 dmg late-game burst; Maximum Belt (ID 1158) grants +50 dmg to ex.

010_apex_bridge_neutralization_v2.json.target_opponent: All 4 Panel Opponents (Crustle, Alakazam, Lucario, Ivan)
010_apex_bridge_neutralization_v2.json.tactical_mechanism: Direct evolution of 002 (31.2% WR) preserving the 4x Mimikyu / 2x Bulu / 2x Munkidori engine while adding Neutralization Zone (ex immunity) and Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex (240 dmg burst).

011_dudunsparce_turbo_draw_engine.json.tactical_mechanism: Structurally distinct archetype with Dunsparce (ID 65) and Dudunsparce (ID 66 Run Away Draw - draw 3 cards/turn and recycle) generating massive hand velocity for Ogerpon Ramp.
